claim: The six nosepiece positions hold, in order from 0 to 5: MRD70040 (CFI Plan Apo Lambda D 4X), MRD70170 (10X), MRD70270 (20X), MRD77400 (CFI Apo Lambda S 40XC WI), MRD71670 (60X Oil) and MRD71970 (100X Oil). The operator confirmed the whole assignment at the instrument.
validity_conditions: This instrument on 2026-09-17, operator read at the instrument. The table arrived as an index from an earlier project's dossier under explicit operator authorisation, and every row was then confirmed here; the specifications of each lens are separate entries citing the catalog part number, never the dossier. Position-to-lens mapping is the one claim on this nosepiece that a single lens swap falsifies, and this instrument's paper record has drifted from its hardware before, so it is re-read rather than inherited. A magnification written here -- 4x, 20x -- is a nominal designation and a string identifier, not a number, and nothing may back-derive it from a calibrated pixel size.
